children.value: > Fact From Story: Lionel Messi starts on the bench for Argentina, but should come into the match early in the second half.
> > Fact From Story: Argentina head coach Lionel Scaloni named a bloated 36-man squad for the matches against Paraguay and Peru this month

> > > Fact From Story: Messi missed the last match against Bolivia, and missed four Inter Miami games after, but he returned for a half-hour of action in their final fixture before the international break.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Players who have missed games may start on the bench to ease them back into play.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A coach determines which players start on the bench.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A player on the bench can enter a match in the second half.
